_readme: check-copy-values.py skips these keys when comparing the two phones' wording.
platform_facts: the two phones genuinely say different TRUE things (hardware/API differences). May only shrink; a meeting must bless any change.
2026-11-16 boss ruling: the three platform-fact keys are frozen to exactly this set — roomLampNote, rewindPlay, netPad. Each side tells its own truth and no unified wording may be written for them:
roomLampNote — iOS has no ambient-light API (says so); Android can be lux-driven.
rewindPlay   — iOS 'Rewind play' (the playback is rewound) vs Android 'Rewind'.
netPad       — iOS writes 'UDP pad (port 4210)' vs Android 'UDP pad (4210)'.
The script asserts this list equals the frozen set: growing it needs a meeting, shrinking it needs a meeting and a value change, not an edit to this file to silence the gate.
2026-11-16: B5 had unified rewindPlay and netPad; the boss's ruling restored each side's own wording and added both keys here.
